name: delegate-wave
description: Deterministic, evidence-driven dispatcher for inexpensive coding workers

scripts.syntax: node -e "const{readdirSync,statSync}=require('node:fs');const{join}=require('node:path');const{execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const walk=d=>readdirSync(d).flatMap(e=>{const p=join(d,e);return statSync(p).isDirectory()?walk(p):(p.endsWith('.js')?[p]:[])});let bad=0;for(const f of walk('src')){try{execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'pipe'})}catch(e){bad++;console.error(f+':\n'+String(e.stderr))}}if(bad)process.exit(1);console.log('syntax ok')"
